query:
DEFINE
    VAR _entity   = TREATAS ( { "P" }, param_entity_view[entity_view_code] )
    VAR _fy       = TREATAS ( { 2026 }, param_fiscal_year[fiscal_year] )
    VAR _month    = TREATAS ( { 6 }, param_period[month_number] )
    VAR _tv       = TREATAS ( { "QTD" }, param_time_view[time_view_code] )
    VAR _base     = TREATAS ( { "LE" }, param_base_version[choice_code] )
    VAR _cmp_a    = TREATAS ( { "B" }, param_compare_a[choice_code] )
    VAR _cmp_b    = TREATAS ( { "NONE" }, param_compare_b[choice_code] )
    VAR _ccy      = TREATAS ( { "EUR" }, param_reporting_currency[currency_code] )
    VAR _fx       = TREATAS ( { "CC" }, param_fx_basis[fx_basis_code] )
    VAR _units    = TREATAS ( { "M" }, param_units[units_code] )
    VAR _regions  = TREATAS ( { "North America", "Continental Europe" }, dim_region[region_name] )
    VAR _channels = TREATAS ( { "Own D2C webstore", "Grocery & mass retail" }, dim_channel[channel_name] )
    VAR _lines =
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
                dim_pl_row[row_key]
                ,dim_pl_row[line_code]
                ,dim_pl_row[line_label]
                ,dim_pl_row[row_type]
                ,dim_pl_row[is_key]
                ,dim_pl_row[tag]
                ,dim_pl_row[line_sort]
                ,TREATAS ( { FALSE () }, dim_pl_row[is_leaf] )
                ,_entity
                ,_fy
                ,_month
                ,_tv
                ,_base
                ,_cmp_a
                ,_cmp_b
                ,_ccy
                ,_fx
                ,_units
                ,_regions
                ,_channels
                ,"@base", CONVERT ( [PL Base], DOUBLE )
                ,"@pct_nr", CONVERT ( [PL % NR], DOUBLE )
                ,"@cmp_a", CONVERT ( [PL Compare A], DOUBLE )
                ,"@d_a", CONVERT ( [PL Δ A], DOUBLE )
                ,"@d_a_pct", CONVERT ( [PL Δ A %], DOUBLE )
                ,"@cmp_b", CONVERT ( [PL Compare B], DOUBLE )
                ,"@d_b", CONVERT ( [PL Δ B], DOUBLE )
                ,"@d_b_pct", CONVERT ( [PL Δ B %], DOUBLE )
                ,"@fy_bud", CONVERT ( [PL FY Budget], DOUBLE )
                ,"@fy_le", CONVERT ( [PL FY LE], DOUBLE )
                ,"@fy_d", CONVERT ( [PL Δ LE vs Budget], DOUBLE )
            )
            ,"row_key", dim_pl_row[row_key]
            ,"line_code", dim_pl_row[line_code]
            ,"line_label", dim_pl_row[line_label]
            ,"row_type", dim_pl_row[row_type]
            ,"is_key", dim_pl_row[is_key]
            ,"tag", dim_pl_row[tag]
            ,"account_code", ""
            ,"account_label", ""
            ,"is_leaf", FALSE ()
            ,"line_sort", dim_pl_row[line_sort]
            ,"account_sort", 0
            ,"@base", [@base]
            ,"@pct_nr", [@pct_nr]
            ,"@cmp_a", [@cmp_a]
            ,"@d_a", [@d_a]
            ,"@d_a_pct", [@d_a_pct]
            ,"@cmp_b", [@cmp_b]
            ,"@d_b", [@d_b]
            ,"@d_b_pct", [@d_b_pct]
            ,"@fy_bud", [@fy_bud]
            ,"@fy_le", [@fy_le]
            ,"@fy_d", [@fy_d]
        )
    VAR _leaves =
        SELECTCOLUMNS (
            SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
                dim_pl_row[row_key]
                ,dim_pl_row[line_code]
                ,dim_pl_row[line_label]
                ,dim_pl_row[row_type]
                ,dim_pl_row[is_key]
                ,dim_pl_row[tag]
                ,dim_pl_row[account_code]
                ,dim_pl_row[account_label]
                ,dim_pl_row[is_leaf]
                ,dim_pl_row[line_sort]
                ,dim_pl_row[account_sort]
                ,TREATAS ( { TRUE () }, dim_pl_row[is_leaf] )
                ,_entity
                ,_fy
                ,_month
                ,_tv
                ,_base
                ,_cmp_a
                ,_cmp_b
                ,_ccy
                ,_fx
                ,_units
                ,_regions
                ,_channels
                ,"@base", CONVERT ( [PL Base], DOUBLE )
                ,"@pct_nr", CONVERT ( [PL % NR], DOUBLE )
                ,"@cmp_a", CONVERT ( [PL Compare A], DOUBLE )
                ,"@d_a", CONVERT ( [PL Δ A], DOUBLE )
                ,"@d_a_pct", CONVERT ( [PL Δ A %], DOUBLE )
                ,"@cmp_b", CONVERT ( [PL Compare B], DOUBLE )
                ,"@d_b", CONVERT ( [PL Δ B], DOUBLE )
                ,"@d_b_pct", CONVERT ( [PL Δ B %], DOUBLE )
                ,"@fy_bud", CONVERT ( [PL FY Budget], DOUBLE )
                ,"@fy_le", CONVERT ( [PL FY LE], DOUBLE )
                ,"@fy_d", CONVERT ( [PL Δ LE vs Budget], DOUBLE )
            )
            ,"row_key", dim_pl_row[row_key]
            ,"line_code", dim_pl_row[line_code]
            ,"line_label", dim_pl_row[line_label]
            ,"row_type", dim_pl_row[row_type]
            ,"is_key", dim_pl_row[is_key]
            ,"tag", dim_pl_row[tag]
            ,"account_code", dim_pl_row[account_code]
            ,"account_label", dim_pl_row[account_label]
            ,"is_leaf", dim_pl_row[is_leaf]
            ,"line_sort", dim_pl_row[line_sort]
            ,"account_sort", dim_pl_row[account_sort]
            ,"@base", [@base]
            ,"@pct_nr", [@pct_nr]
            ,"@cmp_a", [@cmp_a]
            ,"@d_a", [@d_a]
            ,"@d_a_pct", [@d_a_pct]
            ,"@cmp_b", [@cmp_b]
            ,"@d_b", [@d_b]
            ,"@d_b_pct", [@d_b_pct]
            ,"@fy_bud", [@fy_bud]
            ,"@fy_le", [@fy_le]
            ,"@fy_d", [@fy_d]
        )
EVALUATE
UNION ( _lines, _leaves )
ORDER BY [line_sort], [account_sort]
